Later, it will show the view from the back camera and the aura layers will overlay on the live feed from the camera. A toggle will turn on/off the picture in picture element that displays the view of the front facing camera looking at the user.

Face recognition, identification, orientation, sentiment analysis and gaze tracking algorithms will run on the front camera feed so that the system can predict the movement of the aura, the files in it, as well as device motion by the user.

Surface mapping, object detection, measurements and hand tracking algorithm will run in tandem on the rear facing camera feed. This will allow a user to interact with all of the elements in the sceen without touching the screen of the device.

By going through this sequence you will be prompted to input details about your life into a computerized light field Aura. This information belongs to you and will only be shared as per your directions. You can change permissions for information gathering, storage, display, manipulation, distribution and deletion as you feel necessary.

As you go through each experience in building your Aura, you will learn vital new skills for planning your ideal future within a multi-planetary humane civilization. Good Luck.

Each box on the matrix is a programmable object. The Matirx is to be folded into a cylinder, then folded into a torus, then manipulated to be a horn torus. The flat matrix has a front and a back, or think of it as 2 layers, so when it is a cylinder and a torus there is an inside and outside where different content is displayed for the user compared with what is shown to an outside observer.
Content for Inside View by the Aura Operator Only.
Whatever content is attached to these boxes will be shown inside the Aura.
Content for Outside Observers with Permissioned Access.
Content attached to these boxes will be available to people and computers Aura connects to.
Old information exits the Torus at the Centre Point
New information enters the Torus at the Centre Point
As each matrix is filled and/or a new matrix is needed because the use case has changed, the color changes along the RGB color code. So colour codes tell the program which matrix to load.
